scope: Five priorities for qualification/publication from the combined top30 families; not five proven hosting gaps or five authorized builds.
ranking: Judgment based on criteria.json; citations are one input, not a new numeric score.
citation_caveat: Counts describe associated papers in the frozen 2026-10-30 audit, not downloads, unique users, or citations of these exact current releases.

recommendations.action: Prepare existing validated release for public publication
recommendations.download_size: 820,295,132 bytes source ZIP; validated GeoParquet already 945,383,282 bytes
recommendations.reason: Complete validated conversion already exists; broad global lake/basin use and very little conversion work remains.
recommendations.next_check: Port the reusable converter and checks into the standalone dataset record; inspect retained files, preserve source/output hashes, add public packaging and attribution. Add a separately validated spatial layout only if needed.
recommendations.remaining: Private staging is not public publication. Public scripts, PMTiles and Portolan record are not yet prepared.

recommendations.reason: Manageable global network with connectivity/free-flowing attributes; complements existing rivers and lake work.
recommendations.next_check: Retain all reach IDs, geometry, nulls and connectivity attributes; compare full counts and per-feature identities to the released network.
recommendations.remaining: Targeted search found no exact hosted match, not proof of absence. The released network excludes some licensed dam inputs; publication is of the released data, not study recomputation.

recommendations.dataset: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 Occurrence (1984–2024)
recommendations.action: Qualify producer tiles, then register or publish a useful indexed release
recommendations.source_format: GeoTIFF; COG conformance not checked here
recommendations.reason: Highly cited global surface-water layer; existing Source Cooperative mirror covers monthly history, a different product.
recommendations.next_check: Check native COG layout/range access before converting; if producer files already satisfy the access need, register them instead of creating a duplicate mirror.
recommendations.remaining: Current producer v1.5 has corrected Occurrence calculations; it is not the prior audit's v1.4. Preserve the documented Landsat collection seam and version.

recommendations.download_size: 115,507.4 publisher Mbytes; about 116–121 GB; 1,064 annual files
recommendations.reason: Global monthly climate/water-balance time series is well suited to spatial and time-series reads; stronger incremental format value than another raster ZIP mirror.
recommendations.next_check: Start with one complete variable, measure chunked time-series and regional reads, then extend to all 14 variables. Preserve packing, masks, calendar, units and native grid.
recommendations.remaining: Larger job. Current v1.1 metadata declares CC0; confirm this across the pinned release inventory. Do not mix v1.0/v1.1 or transfer older GEE validation. Excludes warming/counterfactual scenarios.

recommendations.download_size: Approximately 15 GB for the public elevation-change raster family
recommendations.reason: A bounded global scientific product with important uncertainty layers and a manageable raster release size.
recommendations.next_check: Confirm redistribution terms for the exact DOI release, then inventory all change/uncertainty tiles and periods; inspect existing TIFF layout before conversion.
recommendations.remaining: Redistribution term not resolved by this check: DataCite rightsList is empty and publisher JSON-LD lacks a named license. Do not mistake the code license for the data license. Excludes ~3 TB monthly elevation series and ~10 TB raw DEMs.
